requirement.normalizedRequirement: Coefficients f_1-f_4 and g_1-g_3 are given in Table 3-3. C_3 = 460 kg/(m^2*s^2), C_4 = 18.7 kg/(m^2*s^2), C_5 = 825 kg/s^2. If the value of the term ((L*T)/B^2)^3 is less than 5, the value 5 shall be used; if the value is more than 20, the value 20 shall be used. Section 3.2.4 applies to IA Super or IA ships whose keel was laid or which were at a similar stage of construction before 1 September 2003. Table 3-3 values: f1=10.3 N/m2, f2=45.8 N/m, f3=2.94 N/m, f4=5.8 N/m2, g1=1530 N, g2=170 N/m, g3=400 N/m1.5.
